stories.story: Max is a playful dog who loves to run outside. Every morning, he goes to the park with his red ball. Max likes to chase the ball across the grass. After playing, he drinks cool water by a tree. Then Max walks home with a happy wagging tail.

Luna is a quiet cat with soft gray fur. She likes to sit by the window on rainy days. Luna watches the raindrops slide down the glass. Sometimes she curls up on the couch for a nap. When she wakes up, Luna stretches and looks for a snack.

Mia is a little rabbit who lives near a garden. She hops outside every morning to pick carrots. Mia carries the carrots in a small basket. One day, she shared a carrot with her friend. Then Mia hopped home before dinner.

Evan is a clever fox who lives in the forest. He likes to walk under the tall trees. One afternoon, Evan heard birds singing nearby. He sat quietly and listened to the happy sounds. Then Evan found a shady spot to rest.

Noah is a big brown bear who loves picnics. He made a sandwich with cheese and tomatoes for lunch. Noah carried his lunch to the lake. After eating, he cleaned up all of his trash. Then Noah relaxed by the water and watched the ducks swim.

Sam is a small green frog who likes rainy weather. He jumped over puddles after the storm ended. Sam splashed water with his feet and laughed. Soon his legs became wet and muddy. Then Sam sat on a rock to dry in the sun.

Ava is a friendly panda who enjoys reading books. She went to school to learn about space. Ava listened carefully to her teacher talk about stars and planets. After class, she drew a big picture of the moon. Then Ava showed her drawing to her friends.

Leo is a lion who loves music and dancing. He played a drum at the school show. Leo made loud beats that everyone could hear. His friends clapped and danced to the music. At the end of the show, Leo bowed to the crowd.

Jay is a silly monkey who likes climbing trees. One morning, he climbed the tallest tree near the river. Jay found a yellow banana hanging from a branch. He ate the banana while waving to his friends below. Then Jay climbed back down for lunch.

Ella is a penguin who lives where the weather is cold. She loves to slide across the ice with her family. Ella laughed as she zoomed past her friends. Later, she went fishing near the water. Then Ella ate dinner and went to sleep.

Toby is a slow turtle who likes sunny days. He walked across the yard to find a warm rock. Toby sat on the rock and looked at the flowers. A butterfly flew near his shell. Then Toby smiled and rested until lunchtime.

Nora is a wise owl who lives in a tall tree. At night, she opens her big eyes and looks around. Nora hears the wind move through the leaves. She watches the moon shine over the forest. Then Nora flies softly back to her nest.

Tina is a striped tiger who loves to paint. She dipped her brush into bright blue paint. Tina made a picture of a river and trees. Her paws got a little messy while she worked. Then Tina hung her painting on the wall.

Owen is a sleepy koala who lives in a tree. He woke up when the sun peeked through the leaves. Owen ate a few green leaves for breakfast. After eating, he waved to his friend below. Then Owen curled up for another nap.

Gia is a tall giraffe who likes helping others. She saw a kite stuck high in a tree. Gia stretched her long neck and reached the kite. She gave it back to a little friend. Then Gia walked proudly across the grass.

Ben is a gentle elephant who loves water. He walked to the pond on a hot afternoon. Ben filled his trunk and sprayed water into the air. His friends laughed as the cool drops fell. Then Ben took a big drink and rested.

Zara is a zebra with bright black and white stripes. She ran across the field with her friends. Zara stopped when she saw fresh grass near a hill. She ate the grass and listened to the birds. Then Zara trotted home before sunset.

Oscar is an octopus who lives under the sea. He likes to collect shiny shells near the sand. Oscar found a purple shell beside a rock. He placed it carefully in his little cave. Then Oscar waved all his arms with joy.

Daisy is a dolphin who loves to jump. She swam quickly through the blue ocean. Daisy leaped out of the water and made a splash. A friend swam beside her and clicked happily. Then Daisy dove deep to look for fish.

Piper is a colorful parrot who likes morning songs. She sat on a branch near the school window. Piper chirped a cheerful tune for the children. The children smiled and waved up at her. Then Piper flew home to tell her family.
